title: Failure of Unique Factorization in Z[√-5]

problemStatement.plain: Formal mathematical investigation: Failure of Unique Factorization in Z[√-5].

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED: No dedicated Lean file for OQ-02. Parent FundamentalArithmetic.lean is complete (0 sorries, 0 axioms). This OQ would need a new file defining Z[√-5] and proving non-UFD. Mathlib has ZMod and NumberField infrastructure that could help.
insights: Parent file has 0 sorries, 0 axioms — fully verified
OQ-02 would need new file: define Z[√-5] ring, show 6 = 2*3 = (1+√-5)(1-√-5), prove 2 is irreducible but not prime
Mathlib has Zsqrtd (Z[√d]) type, and GaussInt. Could use Zsqrtd for Z[√-5]
Key Mathlib: Zsqrtd.norm, Zsqrtd.isPrime_iff for norm-based arguments
